Rectangular preview contact correction covers the complex, with raw terrain kept separately. Exact tent sag, clock typography, calligraphy, mosaic ornament, entrances and thresholds remain approximate or omitted. Existing601/607m datum disagreement remains documented; no new survey is claimed.
